parseNodeDef: 节点A["模块 \"核心\" 处理"]

parseMermaidToGraph.name: dotted-and-inline-labeled-arrows
parseMermaidToGraph.code:
graph LR
  A -.-> B
  C -.- D
  E -- yes --> F
  G == critical ==> H
  I -. optional .-> J

parseMermaidToGraph.name: open-line-connectors-with-dashes
parseMermaidToGraph.code:
graph LR
  A -- open-link --- B
  C == thick-open === D
  E -. dot-open .- F
  G -- my-dashed-label --> H

parseMermaidToGraph.name: ampersand-branching-and-quoted-ampersand
parseMermaidToGraph.code:
graph LR
  A["Source"] --> B["Target 1"] & C["Target 2"]
  D & E -->|merged| F & G
  H["Research & Development"] & I["Design & QA"] --> J["Production & Release"]

parseMermaidToGraph.name: comments-subgraphs-direction-and-quoted-connectors
parseMermaidToGraph.code:
graph TD
  %% This is a comment
  subgraph Core Module
    direction TB
    A["Step 1: Input --> Transform"] --> B["Step 2: Output"]
  end
  style A fill:#f9f
  classDef default fill:#fff
